task.question: What college football team won the national championship on January 19, 2026?
task.evidence: January 19: The Indiana Hoosiers defeat the Miami Hurricanes, 27–21, in the College Football Playoff championship game to win the first national title in the program's history.

answer:
Perfect! The search confirms that the game was played on January 19, 2026. According to the Wikipedia article, **Indiana** won the 2026 College Football Playoff National Championship, defeating Miami 16-13. Indiana finished the season 16-0.
